_comment: Hand-placed drip, in frame-1 pixel coordinates of each 80x80 front/back sprite. hand_front/hand_back = where the gun's grip goes; gun_scale overrides gun size. Types: chain {x1,x2,y,sag} | chain_back {x1,x2,y} | grill {x1,x2,y} | shades {x1,x2,y,h} | jeans {x1,x2,y1,y2} | shoe {x,y,w,style:white|jordan} | cig/pipe {x,y,dir} | brick {x,y,w,h} | weed {x,y,size,tilt} | durag/beanie {x1,x2,y,h,tail_x,tail} (paints over the head) | recolor {hue,sat,lift} | sparkles {n,seed}. head_front / head_back = hand-set eye-level point of the head; the hat sits just above it and the chain below it.

74._name: Geodude: gold grillz, gun in its fist
